literature_notes: All three ledger lines were examined. L1 and L2 both report a C-terminal VSVG epitope tag on full-length human NHE3. The topology landmarks place the C-terminus (residue 834) firmly within IC6 (residues 457–834), the large intracellular regulatory domain; these tags are therefore intracellular and cannot serve as extracellular surface tags. They are recorded in other_positions. L3 reports a myc-tagged NHE3 construct but provides no residue position whatsoever — the quote only states the cDNA 'with a myc-tag was cloned into a pcDNA3.1 vector', giving no indication of whether the tag is N-terminal, C-terminal, or internal. This falls squarely under the disqualifier for a construct whose tag position is unstated. No ledger line supports an extracellular surface tag site on SLC9A3.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal VSVG epitope tag on full-length NHE3 (pcDNA-hNHE3V); residue 834 lies within IC6 (457–834), the large cytoplasmic regulatory domain — this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
C-terminal VSVG tag driven by villin promoter on full-length NHE3; same intracellular C-terminal position as L1 — confirmed intracellular by topology landmarks.
